homepageConfig.storyExcerpt: Every batch of Lumina soap is made slowly using traditional room-temperature saponification. We never use melt-and-pour bases, synthetic foaming chemicals (SLS/SLES), phthalate perfumes, or artificial hardening additives.

brandPages.title: About Lumina Soaps
brandPages.summary: Our artisan philosophy and commitment to natural cold-process skincare.
brandPages.content: Lumina Homemade Soaps was founded in Bengaluru as a dedicated artisan craft studio by Thiru Kailash. We believe everyday bathing should be a restorative sensory ritual rooted in botanical purity. Every bar is hand-measured, small-batch blended, hand-cut, and cured for a full six weeks on cedar drying racks.

brandPages.title: The Cold Process Story
brandPages.summary: The 42-day journey from botanical oils to cured luxury bar.
brandPages.content: Unlike mass-market commercial soaps which extract natural glycerin for high-margin cosmetics, our traditional cold process keeps 100% of the natural botanical glycerin inside the bar. Saponification happens gently over 48 hours, followed by 42 days of open-air curing on aromatic cedar racks to achieve natural hardness and long-lasting lather.

brandPages.title: The Artisan Workshop
brandPages.summary: Indiranagar studio operations, sanitation and batch records.
brandPages.content: Located in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, our micro-soapery adheres to strict hygiene, food-grade stainless steel blending, and cedar wood rack storage. Each wooden mould pours exactly 48 to 60 bars per batch, numbered with batch traceability codes.

brandPages.title: Soap Care Instructions
brandPages.summary: How to prolong the life of your natural botanical soap bar.
brandPages.content: Because cold-process soaps contain high amounts of natural glycerin without chemical hardeners, they thrive when kept dry between uses. We recommend placing your bar on a slatted wooden soap dish with good drainage, away from direct shower spray.

brandPages.title: Shipping Policy
brandPages.summary: Pan-India courier delivery times, dispatch schedule and rates.
brandPages.content: All orders are handcrafted and packaged with biodegradable paper packaging and dispatched from Bengaluru within 24 to 48 business hours. We deliver across India via India Post Speed Post, Blue Dart, DTDC, and Delhivery. Standard delivery fee is ₹50 for orders below ₹799; orders ₹799 and above enjoy Free Delivery.

brandPages.title: Cancellation Policy
brandPages.summary: Cancellation guidelines prior to artisan order dispatch.
brandPages.content: Orders may be cancelled free of charge before they are handed over to our dispatch courier. Once an order is handed over and a tracking number is generated, standard return guidelines apply.

brandPages.title: Return & Refund Policy
brandPages.summary: Hygiene considerations and transit damage resolution.
brandPages.content: Due to personal hygiene and bath safety regulations, used soap bars cannot be returned. If an item arrives damaged in transit or incorrect items were received, notify us within 48 hours of delivery for an immediate replacement or full refund.

brandPages.title: Privacy Policy
brandPages.summary: Protection of customer shipping and account details.
brandPages.content: We hold customer trust sacred. Personal details including name, address, phone number, and purchase history are kept strictly confidential for order fulfillment and customer support. We never sell, lease, or monetize customer data.

brandPages.title: Terms & Conditions
brandPages.summary: Single-proprietorship sales terms and natural variations.
brandPages.content: Lumina Homemade Soaps is operated as a sole-proprietor business in Bengaluru, Karnataka. Natural color variations, herb fleck patterns, and slight weight differences (+/- 5g) reflect genuine handmade cold-process methods and are not defects.

brandPages.content: For any inquiries, custom bridal batch requests, or order assistance, write directly to proprietor Thiru Kailash at mailmethirukailash@gmail.com or via WhatsApp at +91 98765 43210 (Mon-Sat, 9 AM to 6 PM IST).

faqs.question: What makes cold-process soap superior to commercial store-bought bars?
faqs.answer: Commercial soaps typically remove natural glycerin to sell separately in moisturizing creams, replacing it with synthetic detergents (surfactants like SLS) and petroleum preservatives. Our cold process retains 100% of natural plant glycerin, creating a mild bar that respects your skin barrier.

faqs.question: Why do you cure soaps for 42 days on cedar drying racks?
faqs.answer: The 42-day curing process allows all residual moisture to evaporate naturally while the crystalline soap lattice completes full saponification. This produces a hard, long-lasting bar with dense, gentle foam that will not dissolve into mush in your soap dish.

faqs.question: Are Lumina soaps safe for sensitive and eczema-prone skin?
faqs.answer: Yes! We formulate several ultra-mild bars such as our Kashmiri Saffron & Raw Honey, Goat Milk & Forest Honey, and Unscented Pure Castile with zero synthetic fragrance, zero artificial coloring, and soothing botanical butters.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take across India?
faqs.answer: Orders are dispatched within 24-48 business hours from our Bengaluru soapery. Standard metro transit takes 2-4 days; non-metro locations take 4-6 days via India Post Speed Post or express couriers.

faqs.question: How long does a single 135g Lumina soap bar last?
faqs.answer: When placed on a draining soap dish that lets water drip away between baths, a 135g bar typically lasts 3 to 4 weeks with daily full-body use by an individual.
